title: Shadowmoon Fortress
wikitext: [[Image:Draenor_map.jpg|thumb|Fortress Shadowmoon's location.]][[Image:Draenoractiii.jpg|thumb|Ingame map showing "Fortress Shadowmoon".]]A fortress of [[Ner'zhul]]'s located on Shadowmoon Clan lands on the southern Peninsula of Draenor in Warcraft II. It was destroyed by Alliance forces. After its destruction [[Khadgar]] and [[Turalyon]] searched the ruins for evidence of the [[Book of Medivh]], but could not find it.
